The Typing Lab needs a physical keyboard. You can look around on a phone, but do the lessons and tests on a computer or a tablet with a keyboard.

Top row · Lesson 9 of 28

T and Y

Index fingers again, reaching a little farther: left index up and right to T, right index up and left to Y.

New keys:TY

ftf ftf jyj jyj tt yy yt yt ty yt ftf jyj

Press F with your left index finger.

Accuracy so far: 100% (pass at 95%)
